description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for implementing AMQP 1.0 services within the Eclipse Hono framework. It manages AMQP server setup, connection handling, endpoint registration, security, and lifecycle management, providing a foundational structure for concrete subclasses to extend with specific service behavior.

classes.name: AmqpServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionalities for AMQP 1.0 based services, such as server setup, connection management, endpoint registration, security handling, and lifecycle control within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the service name used for container identification in AMQP connections.

methods.name: addEndpoints
methods.description: Registers a list of AmqpEndpoint instances to the service, allowing dynamic endpoint inclusion.

methods.name: addEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a single AmqpEndpoint to the internal registry, with warning if a duplicate name exists.

methods.name: getEndpoint (by ResourceIdentifier)
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint associated with the specified target address resource.

methods.name: getEndpoint (by String)
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint registered under the specified name.

methods.name: endpoints
methods.description: Provides an iterable of all registered endpoints.

methods.name: setSaslAuthenticatorFactory
methods.description: Configures the SASL authenticator factory used during server setup.

methods.name: setAuthorizationService
methods.description: Sets the authorization service responsible for access control.

methods.name: getAuthorizationService
methods.description: Returns the current authorization service instance.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Initializes the server based on configuration, including endpoint startup and server socket binding, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: closeExpiredConnection
methods.description: Closes a connection whose associated user token has expired.

methods.name: preStartServers
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to do additional initializations before server socket binding.

methods.name: startEndpoints
methods.description: Starts all registered endpoints asynchronously.

methods.name: stopEndpoints
methods.description: Stops all registered endpoints asynchronously.

methods.name: startInsecureServer
methods.description: Starts the insecure (non-SSL/TLS) AMQP server if enabled.

methods.name: startSecureServer
methods.description: Starts the secure (SSL/TLS) AMQP server if enabled.

methods.name: createProtonServer
methods.description: Creates a ProtonServer instance configured with optional SASL authentication.

methods.name: createServerOptions
methods.description: Constructs server options including TLS configuration; override for customization.

methods.name: createInsecureServerOptions
methods.description: Creates default options for non-secure server sockets, including heartbeat and frame size.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Stops servers and endpoints, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the secure server asynchronously.

methods.name: stopInsecureServer
methods.description: Stops the insecure server asynchronously.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the actual port number the secure server is listening on, or a configured default.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the actual port number the insecure server is listening on, or a configured default.

methods.name: onRemoteConnectionOpen
methods.description: Handles the event of new secure connection establishment, setting container name and handlers.

methods.name: onRemoteConnectionOpenInsecurePort
methods.description: Handles the event of new insecure connection establishment, setting container name and handlers.

methods.name: handleUnknownEndpoint
methods.description: Closes links targeting unknown endpoints with an 'amqp:not-found' error.

methods.name: getResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a ResourceIdentifier object from a raw address string, considering tenant configuration.

methods.name: handleReceiverOpen
methods.description: Handles an incoming Receiver link, authorizing and associating it with a registered endpoint.

methods.name: handleSenderOpen
methods.description: Handles an incoming Sender link, authorizing and associating it with a registered endpoint.

methods.name: setRemoteConnectionOpenHandler
methods.description: Sets default handlers on a ProtonConnection for sessions, links, disconnects, and open events.

methods.name: processRemoteOpen
methods.description: Processes the client's open frame and schedules connection expiration based on token validity.

methods.name: processDesiredCapabilities
methods.description: Hook to process client's desired capabilities; default does nothing.

methods.name: handleSessionOpen
methods.description: Handles session open event, defaulting to opening the session.

methods.name: publishConnectionClosedEvent
methods.description: Notifies all registered endpoints that a connection has been closed.

methods.name: handleRemoteConnectionClose
methods.description: Handles client-initiated connection close, disconnects and publishes event.

methods.name: handleRemoteDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection event by disconnecting and publishing event.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers readiness health checks for all endpoints.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers liveness health checks for all endpoints.
